about: Every command a user can run, kept complete by tests/test_feature_map.py. Upper-case words in a command are placeholders.

features.name: Extract TLE history from the tle-archive git history
features.description: Pulls the TLE history of chosen objects out of the OndroNR/tle-archive git history, 2021-2023.
features.command: python -m orbit_watch.jobs.extract_tle_archive --out DIR --norad ID [--norad ID ...] [--name-regex REGEX]
inputs: the OndroNR/tle-archive GitHub repository, cloned by the job
NORAD ids or an object-name regex

features.name: Build the GEO-region TLE set
features.description: Picks every object in the GEO region from yearly full-catalogue TLE bundles and writes its TLE history.
features.command: python -m orbit_watch.jobs.geo_belt build --source URL --bundle PATH_OR_GLOB [--bundle ...] --out DIR_OR_ZIP [--also ID ...]
inputs: TLE bundles as .txt files or inside .zip files
the bundles' source URL, recorded in the manifest
outputs: both in a directory or in one .zip

features.name: Add SATCAT entries to the GEO-region set
features.description: Adds each object's Space-Track SATCAT entry (type, launch, decay) to the GEO-region manifest.
features.command: hush run -- python -m orbit_watch.jobs.geo_belt satcat --out DIR
outputs: the SATCAT query cached under data/spacetrack beside DIR

features.name: Label GEO operating modes
features.description: Labels the operating mode of every GEO-region object in 30-day windows, 2021-2025.
inputs: GEO-DIR/manifest.json and GEO-DIR/<norad>.tle from the GEO-region set

features.name: Compare GEO modes with ESA's classification
features.description: Prints, per ESA 2019 class, how many objects have the matching mode in early 2021.
inputs: pdftotext output of ESA's Classification of Geosynchronous Objects, Issue 21
segments.csv from the GEO modes job

features.name: Fetch element sets for the generalisation run
features.description: Fetches Space-Track gp_history once for each satellite in the generalisation run, over its manoeuvre-log span.
inputs: optional NORAD ids (default: all six satellites)
outputs: counts and file sizes on stdout

features.name: Fetch element sets for the labelled objects
features.description: Fetches Space-Track gp_history for 2021-2025 for each object added in groundtruth/splits.json.
outputs: counts and file sizes on stdout

features.name: Run a command on Kaggle
features.description: Runs a command on Kaggle CPU against the commit at HEAD and downloads what it wrote.
features.command: python tools/kaggle_run.py [--slug SLUG] [--attach PATH ...] [--dataset OWNER/SLUG ...] [-- COMMAND ...]
outputs: data/kaggle/<slug>/out: COMMIT.txt, run.log, exit_code.txt and the command's outputs

features.name: Write the labelled-objects table
features.description: Writes groundtruth/objects.md, one row per labelled object with its burn and element-set counts.
inputs: cached Space-Track gp_history files in TLE-DIR

features.name: Detector evaluation
features.description: Scores the step detector per regime (ISS, LEO, GEO, IGSO) against fixed periods, objects and targets.
features.command: python -m harness.evals.detector --split SPLIT [--final] --data-dir DIR [--settings JSON] [--truth-dir DIR] [--out JSON]

features.name: Calibrate the detector on the ISS
features.description: Picks the detector thresholds on 2021-2022 ISS burns and scores 2023 once with them.

features.name: Score the ISS holdout and cross-validate
features.description: Scores the frozen detector on Space-Track ISS history for 2024-2025, then runs leave-one-year-out cross-validation.
features.command: python -m orbit_watch.holdout --gp PATH --archive PATH --truth CSV [CSV ...] --out DIR
outputs: OUT/holdout_2024_2025/: detections.csv, events_scored.csv, report.json and a plot
OUT/cv_2021_2025/: detections.csv, events_scored.csv, report.json and cv_scores.png

features.name: Injection-recovery test on the ISS
features.description: Adds synthetic steps to the real ISS series in memory and measures recall by step size and false alarms on quiet stretches.

features.name: Score the detector on operator logs
features.description: Scores the ISS-tuned detector, and a per-regime tune, against IDS (LEO) and QZSS (GEO) manoeuvre logs.
inputs: Space-Track gp_history files, or GEO-region TLEs

features.name: GEO step and longitude hunt
features.description: Finds semi-major-axis steps in a few GEO objects and reports the longitude and drift rate around each.

features.name: Build ground truth from operator logs
features.description: Turns the published IDS, QZSS and Fengyun manoeuvre logs into the ground-truth CSVs, one row per source row.
features.command: python -m orbit_watch.manoeuvre_logs --ids-dir DIR --qzss-dir DIR --fengyun-dir DIR --out DIR

features.name: Write the train and holdout split
features.description: Prints the train/holdout split of the labelled objects from its fixed rule, and writes it with --write.
inputs: the labelled objects and the split rule in orbit_watch/truth.py
